landing.heroTitleLine1: Your edge is in your mind
landing.heroSubtitle: 90 seconds. One breath. Your best decision.
landing.featuresIntro: Kognit is with you before, during, and after every moment of tension: guided protocols to lower stress, emotional anchoring habits, coaching cards, a personal journal, and a community training on the same frequency as you.

reset.title: Reset (Protocol)
reset.description: Lower your emotional intensity in 35 or 90 seconds with guided breathing, grounding, and automatic progress tracking.

calmAnchor.title: Calm Anchor
calmAnchor.description: Your personal mental anchor, always within reach on the home screen: breathe, trigger your gesture and phrase, and return to the present in seconds.

cards.title: Mental Cards
cards.description: 50 coaching cards (5 categories x 10) with reflective questions, insights, and practical actions. Free: 1 random card per day. Premium: unlimited access.

journal.title: Journal & Calendar
journal.description: Daily notes with optional images, emotional pattern tracking, and daily trends.

community.title: Community
community.description: Shared reflections, reactions, and private messages. No followers or rankings, just mutual support.

profile.title: Your Progress
profile.description: Focus score, emotional control, streak, XP, and full history to see your evolution.
